counting_rule: Exactly 42 registered world prefab families; composite meshes and shared primitives permitted; palette/LOD variations do not create IDs. Avatar, wearable cosmetics, UI, textures, lights and render effects excluded.

assets.name: Straight track
assets.construction: Parametric extruded deck, patterned top, visible rim, separate underside.
assets.notes: Entry/exit route sockets; length 18–30 m; width normally 4 m.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Curved track
assets.construction: Extrude the same cross-section along a gentle planar curve; preserve checker UV spacing.
assets.notes: Left/right from signed curvature; no separately counted mirrored prefab; validate lookahead.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Rising/falling ramp
assets.construction: Smooth deck with continuous height profile, not an obstacle or speed boost.
assets.notes: Grade capped at 18 degrees initially; appearance can be grander outside the play strip.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Straight staircase
assets.construction: Repeated visible treads and risers over a continuous logical walk surface.
assets.notes: Ordinary stairs are automatic. Explicit oversized 0.72 m risers require a jump; missing support intervals are real gaps.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Curved staircase
assets.construction: Stair treads arranged along a broad curved centreline.
assets.notes: Gentle curvature; player/camera follow the route automatically.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Spiral staircase
assets.construction: Large-radius ascending/descending helix assembled from wedge treads.
assets.notes: Gameplay radius at least 24 m; no tight blind spiral, camera obstruction, or roll.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Floating platform / landing
assets.construction: Broad beveled slab, round or rounded-square outline; patterned certified landing zone.
assets.notes: Used for plazas, drop landings and step-like sequences; cosmetic widening does not increase steering range.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Broken track / missing steps
assets.construction: Paired ledges or stair groups with explicit empty support intervals.
assets.notes: Real gap mask in simulation, not merely a black texture; telegraph based on current maximum speed.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Arch
assets.construction: Open classical/rounded arch with actual hole, two uprights and curved lintel.
assets.notes: Ordinary arches have generous clearance; certified low-arch variant has a conspicuous underpass.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Column
assets.construction: Fluted or smooth shaft, base and capital; instanced colonnades.
assets.notes: A validated horizontal low-column template may be a jump obstacle; random scenery never acquires collision.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Void mirror gateway
assets.construction: Freestanding rounded/ornate frame and opaque black inset with restrained sheen.
assets.notes: Opening straddles the runnable ribbon; passing through mutates the visual grammar, never kills.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Open window frame
assets.construction: Frame plus two hinged/open casements; no painted pretend opening.
assets.notes: Decorative open casements remain noncolliding. A descending full-width physical frame is a slide hazard with 0.85 m underpass clearance.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Open room / liminal courtyard
assets.construction: Walls, doorway-like openings and ceiling strips built as one parameterized room family.
assets.notes: Room floor uses existing track/water instances; keep traversal exit visible.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Small strange house
assets.construction: Simple recognizable pitched-roof house with inset windows and door geometry.
assets.notes: Can float, repeat or invert off-track; never an exit or secret win trigger.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Tower
assets.construction: Narrow tiered tower with strong distant silhouette; optional existing window instances.
assets.notes: Landmark from 100–500 m away; do not spawn an unregistered skyline kit.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Fountain
assets.construction: Basin, stem and tiers; water is material/particles or asset 25.
assets.notes: Small courtyard object or huge suspended landmark; no random gameplay effect.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Unoccupied chair
assets.construction: Recognizable seat, back and legs, with subtly ornate silhouette.
assets.notes: Scenery is noncolliding. Clearly placed low sleeping-chair barriers on the track require jumping; not an ending.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Bed
assets.construction: Pillow, mattress, low frame and simple headboard.
assets.notes: Scenery and certified soft landing dressings remain distinct from low physical jump barriers on the track.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Dream tree
assets.construction: Trunk and branching silhouette with optional clustered canopy.
assets.notes: Bare, fuzzy, chrome and giant material/scale treatments reuse this family.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Oversized flower
assets.construction: Curved stem, leaves, distinct petals and centre.
assets.notes: Meadow clusters or monumental overhead flowers; never hide an active hazard.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Mushroom
assets.construction: Curved stem, cap, underside and optional procedural spots.
assets.notes: May repeat into forests or appear alone; no secret power-up.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Rock
assets.construction: Seeded low-frequency displaced rounded rock with controllable faceting.
assets.notes: Can be pearl, glass-like or velvet; not a route surface without an existing landing/track instance.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Mountain / cliff mass
assets.construction: Large low-detail eroded silhouette with inset rock planes.
assets.notes: Distant backdrop; cloud and track instances can surround it.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Cloud / fluffy mass
assets.construction: Soft clustered volumes with an opaque stylized fallback; low transparent overdraw.
assets.notes: A storm cloud can telegraph a fixed lightning target for at least two active seconds. A cloud alone never promises a safe landing.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Water / reflective plane
assets.construction: Bounded tileable plane with animated normal/ripple treatment.
assets.notes: Ocean, flooded room or black reflecting surface; not automatically walkable or safe to fall into.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Moon
assets.construction: Sphere/disc with a restrained crater texture and optional crescent mask.
assets.notes: Decorative moons remain noncolliding. A physical moon suspended from a ribbon swings across the track; no luck effect.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Balloon
assets.construction: Rounded inflated body, pinched neck, knot and lightweight curved string.
assets.notes: Collectible form small, reachable, halo-marked and worth exactly one balloon; giant scenery form is unmarked.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Heart
assets.construction: Rounded 3D heart with clear central notch, not two disconnected spheres.
assets.notes: A visual object only in v1; hearts are not currency, lives or upgrades.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Star
assets.construction: Rounded five-point extruded star.
assets.notes: Floating decoration and optional cosmetic motif; no second currency.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Football / soccer ball
assets.construction: Sphere with recognizable contrasting football panel pattern.
assets.notes: Predictable rolling towards runner; one hit causes stumble, not automatic waking.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Eight-ball
assets.construction: Glossy near-black sphere with two readable white number-8 patches.
assets.notes: Preserve identifying patch; recolouring cannot turn it into the nazar.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Softball / tennis-like ball
assets.construction: Yellow-green round ball with curved seam detail.
assets.notes: Matches the supplied round sports-ball motif; deterministic path, no random bounce into safe space.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: American football
assets.construction: Prolate body, pointed-ish ends, laces and end stripes.
assets.notes: Visual tumble with a stable predictable hazard corridor; no physics-driven erratic ricochets.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Blue evil-eye ball
assets.construction: Round blue glass-like body bearing navy/white/light-blue/black concentric eye motif.
assets.notes: This is the blue amulet motif, NOT an anatomical eyeball. Keep motif orientation readable as it rolls.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Floating ribbon / bow
assets.construction: Extruded curved band with optional bow loop, built from a swept strip.
assets.notes: Low transverse ribbon is a certified slide template; other placements are non-colliding.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Freestanding curtain
assets.construction: Two lightweight pleated cloth panels on an invisible or simple integrated header.
assets.notes: Certified slide version has a visible lower opening; no opaque blind collision plane.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Four-leaf clover
assets.construction: Exactly four distinct heart-shaped leaves on a short stem.
assets.notes: Appears only attached to lucky pig events and owned rewards/ending; never an independent currency or random pickup.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Bridge balustrade / railing
assets.construction: Repeating balusters and top rail; connectors allow straight or curved instancing.
assets.notes: Frames bridges/stairs; cannot imply solid protection where simulation allows a fall.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Horse
assets.construction: Elegant recognizably equine body, four separated legs, mane, tail and head.
assets.notes: Slide template enlarges belly clearance; scenery horses may be monumental. No harm to animal.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Zebra
assets.construction: Stockier equine silhouette, upright mane, striped coat and four separated legs.
assets.notes: Not merely an invisible box with stripes. Leg gap must be visible and match collision geometry.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Rabbit
assets.construction: Small soft rabbit with long ears, rounded body, haunches and tail.
assets.notes: Looks cute, never bloodshot or monstrous. On-track collision instantly ends run; off-track is scenery.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license

assets.name: Lucky pig
assets.construction: Small friendly round pig with snout, ears, four short legs and curly tail.
assets.notes: Ordinary pig is an avoidable soft obstacle; clover pig is collectible. Same pig family dresses the three-pig ending.
assets.source: original procedural mesh/prefab; imported replacement permitted only with recorded license
